title: Banana - Green: modeled ₹1,397/qtl left, Kalpetta → Kondotty
summary: January 2025: reported banana - Green prices at Kalpetta and Kondotty imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 16 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,397 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 222 same-variety market pairs screened for banana - Green in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kondotty report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Kalpetta (Kerala) and Kondotty (Kerala) both reported banana - Green prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 16 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kalpetta reported a median ₹5,050 per quintal. Kondotty reported a median ₹7,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,100/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,100 per quintal, and Kondotty was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 76 km by road
scenes.caption: 76 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹16/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,476 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹1,125 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kondotty report, the rule selects 16 of 16 modeled shipping days. 16 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,397 per quintal (₹1,036 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kalpetta to Kondotty was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹139,700, or ₹103,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to banana - Green
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹16/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kalpetta to Kondotty was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹139,700, or ₹103,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

conclusion: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kattappana to Kollam was positive on 94% of matched days in September 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹93,800, or ₹65,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
